<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a quest item first obtained from [[Miss Chain]], to be given to [[Ms. Charm]] as part of her quest-line. It is not craftable, despite its description claiming that it can be crafted at the [[church workbench]] - no known recipe exists. Sometime later, one may purchase it from [[Ms. Charm]], yet it has no other known application.
